operations.name: kb_search
operations.description: Full-text search across the knowledge base wiki articles.

operations.name: kb_search_raw
operations.description: Fallback full-text search over the raw/ ingest directory (pre-compile source material). Use when kb_search misses — raw holds verbatim scraped sources, dictionaries, and book chapters that may contain exact wording lost during compile.

operations.name: kb_ask
operations.description: Ask a question against the knowledge base (deep research with context retrieval). Set promote=true to let the LLM judge whether to sediment the Q&A as a new wiki concept.

api_key.description: Per-request LLM API key override. HTTP callers MUST use the X-LLM-Key header instead; the /api/ask body is rejected with 400 if any api_key-like field is present.

operations.name: kb_get
operations.description: Get a wiki article by slug (alias-aware: accepts Chinese/pinyin/English names). Optional `section` param extracts just that section's subtree (heading + content + descendants); use kb_get_sections first to discover anchors.

section.description: Section anchor from kb_get_sections (e.g. h2-緒論-bb6572)

operations.name: kb_get_sections
operations.description: Get the section tree (table of contents) for an article. Each section has level, title, anchor, start/end character offsets, and nested children. Anchors are stable across cosmetic title edits and sibling reorders.

operations.name: kb_list
operations.description: List all wiki articles with titles and tags. Optional tag filter.

operations.name: kb_backlinks
operations.description: Find all articles that reference a given article.

operations.name: kb_taxonomy
operations.description: Get the hierarchical category tree of the knowledge base.

operations.name: kb_stats
operations.description: Knowledge-base statistics: article count, raw count, word count.

operations.name: kb_ingest
operations.description: Ingest a URL or local file path into the raw corpus.

operations.name: kb_compile
operations.description: Compile raw documents into wiki articles. full=true recompiles everything.

operations.name: kb_lint
operations.description: Run health checks on the KB. Legacy: fix=true delegates to kb_lint_fix.

operations.name: kb_lint_fix
operations.description: Auto-fix lint issues (metadata, broken links, duplicates, categories).

operations.name: kb_export_article
operations.description: Export a single article with full context (linked articles, backlinks).

operations.name: kb_export_tag
operations.description: Export all articles with a given tag.

operations.name: kb_export_graph
operations.description: Export the subgraph around an article up to a given depth.

operations.name: kb_export
operations.description: Legacy unified export (type: article/tag/graph). Prefer kb_export_article/tag/graph.

operations.name: kb_rebuild_index
operations.description: Rebuild the wiki index, aliases, backlinks metadata.

operations.name: kb_xici
